name: PDF Manager
description: Admin tool that scans the site for PDF files (database + physical) and lets admins bulk-download them as a ZIP, export a CSV, and replace PDFs.
project_description: The PDF Manager module provides a streamlined solution for bulk managing PDF assets within Drupal. It simplifies the often tedious process of updating existing documents by allowing users to replace multiple files simultaneously through a unified interface. Beyond simple management, it provides an immediate administrative overview, summarizing the total count and cumulative file size of your document library, ensuring your site remains performant and organized.
